text:
sam_support: Escalating CuraTech onboarding — provisioning 403 during account activation. Customer missed 2 enablement sessions, now showing renewal risk. Creating handoff to CS. Ticket INC-8921.

devon_se: I pulled logs — 403 from /v1/provision, looks like missing service_principal header. Example request:```curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"tenant_id":"cura-123"}'``` returns 403.

aisha_csm: On it. I can do a 30m troubleshooting slot at 12:00 PT today. @tom_cs_ops can you join for comms & renewal flag? Need a short comms plan and a fallback we can offer the customer immediately.

tom_cs_ops: I can join 12:00 PT. Proposed comms plan: 1) Immediate 30m triage call, 2) Offer temporary activation key (24h) if we need time, 3) Post-call enablement checklist + recording, 4) Flag for renewal outreach. I'll draft the email after dev confirms workaround.

julie_product: If the issue is token/tenant mismatch we can regenerate tenant token from admin UI. That typically fixes 90%. @devon_se can you confirm risk (re-deploy required) & whether we can automate a short-lived key?

devon_se: Confirm regenerate tenant token is the fix in most cases. Risk = customers must rotate keys in their infra. Short-term workaround: add permissive header check for 2 hours to accept legacy service_principal values while we rotate — low risk if limited window.

sam_support: ops-bot created INC-8921 and paged oncall. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-8921 :rotating_light:

ops-bot: Incident INC-8921 created by sam_support. Severity: P1. Current assignees: devon_se, aisha_csm.

aisha_csm: Draft email to customer: "Hi CuraTech — we're aware of the activation failure and are working on a fix. Can you join a 30-min troubleshooting call at 12:00 PT today? We can issue a temporary activation key while we investigate." I'll send after thumbs-up.

tom_cs_ops: Approved. I'll add renewal flag in CRM and schedule 48h follow-up. I'll also prepare an enablement doc snippet for token rotation and record the session.

sam_support: Next steps: 12:00 PT triage call, devon to attempt token regen + permissive header if needed, tom to prep comms + CRM flag, aisha to send invite and capture VOC. Update this thread after call. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
